input_parameters.end_radius: Outer Kerr event horizon BL coordinate r_plus=rg*(1+sqrt(1-chi^2))

physical_equations.r_geometric: rg=GM/c² and a=chi rg, BL equatorial y=r/rg
physical_equations.BL_azimuthal_frame_dragging: dphi/dtau=(c/rg)*2 chi/(y*delta), delta=y²-2y+chi²; BL coordinate diverges at horizon and is not physical local rotation rate
physical_equations.proper_time_integral: tau(y)=rg/c * integral_y^200 [y'^(3/2) / sqrt(2(y'^2+chi²))] dy', adaptive domain via composite Simpson 1280 panels
physical_equations.Carter_coframe: omega0=(sqrt(delta)/y)(dx0−chi dphi); omega1=(y/sqrt(delta))dy; omega2=y dtheta; omega3=(P dphi−chi dx0)/y, x0=ct/rg
physical_equations.observer_internal: u=(A,B,0,D), A=P/(y sqrt(delta)), B=-sqrt(2 y P)/(y sqrt(delta)), D=-chi/y
physical_equations.parallel_rotation_phase: Marck dPsi/dtau =sqrt(K)/(r²+K)*(E+a/(Lz−aE))=0 in special E=1 Lz=0 Q=0 case; chi=0 continuous zero limit
physical_equations.tidal_tensor_eigenvalues_s2: (2+3 chi²/y², −1−3 chi²/y², −1) GM/r³, oriented radial/stretch/polar/azimuth in specified parallel tetrad
physical_equations.tidal_trace: sum lambda_i = 0 exactly in Kerr vacuum
physical_equations.numeric_boundary_condition: Only r>r_plus*(1+1e-7) has finite BL tetrad vector output. At horizon eigenvalues are exterior limits.

selected_results.Kerr_vs_Schwarzschild_comparison: Same BL coordinate radius and same E,Lz,Q initial constants; horizons are different radii, so horizon-vs-horizon values not matched events.
selected_results.proper_clock_datasets: 729 actual evenly spaced modeled proper-time FRACTIONS per spin for four spins: 2916 rows, separate from 729 historical logarithmic radius grid
selected_results.log_radius_witness: 2916 rows (729 source radius labels ×4 assumed spins) with blank all interior, zero sentinel and out-of-start tidal field values

full_Riemann_Christoffel_projection_test.independent_of_closed_form_curvature: YES, Christoffels and Riemann generated from numerical BL metric derivatives

independent_validation.separate_from_analytic_tidal_formula: Independent finite-difference Kerr BL metric -> metric inverse -> gamma -> full Riemann -> projection onto tetrad
independent_validation.parallel_transport_condition: u^nu nabla_nu e_i^mu approximately zero, nine exterior checks
independent_validation.mock_browser_control_test: PASS: spin selections 0/.9/.99, horizon frame guard, proper clock reset/midpoint, 24! 000->001 and closing/reverse, invalid-rank guard

limitations: Real Sgr A* spin is not fitted or measured in this model; chi values are hypothetical.

E=1,Lz=0,Q=0 is a special equatorial zero-angular-momentum plunge from rest at infinity. Coordinate dphi/dtau !=0 in Kerr due to frame dragging; the worldline is not constant-phi in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates.

Parallel frame vectors are represented in a Carter coframe singular at outer Kerr horizon; their components are withheld at and below that surface. Exterior tidal eigenvalues have finite horizon limits.

The Kerr r coordinate is Boyer-Lindquist, not an intrinsic areal radius; comparing two chi values at same BL r is a declared coordinate-equatorial diagnostic, not a universal metric-invariant radial-distance comparison.
Proper-time values are numerical integration results with fixed Simpson quadrature; no external observer's Schwarzschild/Boyer-Lindquist coordinate time is asserted to be finite at the horizon.
Only the electric tidal eigenvalues of test-particle geodesic deviation are computed. No full magnetic tidal tensor, dynamic finite-body elasticity, stress waves or fracture.
These derived local tensor values are model calculations, not measured observations. No physical GR interior solution or 000 center was inferred.
The Schwarzschild and Kerr source values in prior 13 bounds have not been modified, nor the 729 original linear field observations or symbolic 24! toroidal ring.
